prose: Astrotheology author David Warner Mathisen returns to InnerVerse alongside fan favorite Mario Garza for a comprehensive overview of the symbolism in myth and religion that is contained within the enigmatic serpent-bearing constellation, Ophiuchus. Join us to learn of the vast array of wisdom characters derived from the mysterious asterism, and what they teach us about the gateway through which trauma programming is transcended, and the recovery of the higher self and divine spark.
